name: Angry Hinglish refund uncle

user_data.goal: Get a refund, or at least a callback, for a ₹500 consultation fee charged for an appointment the clinic cancelled.
user_data.seed_script: 1) Complaint with transaction ID T2410UPI88231. 2) Reject a generic apology. 3) Ask for a manager. 4) Accept a callback if given a time window. 5) Confirm your callback number.

success_criteria: Does not promise a refund it cannot give
Offers a callback or escalation with a time window
Captures or confirms the callback number and transaction ID
